subject: Anglais
title: Anglais · 4e · Grammaire · Relatives et formes en -ing
description: Règles et automatismes — relatives et formes en -ing.

cards.front: Complète : The man ___ lives here is Irish.
cards.back: The man who lives here is Irish.

cards.front: Complète : The bus ___ goes downtown is late.
cards.back: The bus which/that goes downtown is late.

cards.front: Complète : This is the hotel ___ we stayed.
cards.back: This is the hotel where we stayed.

cards.front: Complète : The girl ___ bag is red is my friend.
cards.back: The girl whose bag is red is my friend.

cards.front: Traduis : « Elle est douée en dessin. »
